suitability.rationale: Purified haspin with an ADP activity readout directly addresses biochemical inhibition and limits cellular conclusions.
response_quotes: A purified-kinase workflow addresses that endpoint; it does not demonstrate cellular effects.

numerical_soundness.rationale: Honestly abstains from numerical series and replicate choices without inventing evidence. Null series fields cannot earn a fully justified numerical design score.
response_quotes: No justified numerical series is provided.

not_assessable_components: Comparability of retained haspin measurements with the proposed purified-kinase assay.
Validated reaction and detection settings and control performance are not supplied.
assumption_handling: Consistently labels unsupported settings unresolved and makes no unsupported potency or source claim. Honest abstention leaves parameter design incomplete.

numeric_check.notes: All series settings and replicates are null; numerical abstention with no arithmetic to check.

review_reason: Assay compatibility and operational parameters require domain validation before execution.
